test2_order_shuffle.note: both = the whole nested selection rerun on shuffled histories (dates kept, scores permuted across a patient's date slots); deploy = rules selected on true order, held-out histories shuffled

test6_missing_records.note: each endoscopy independently missing from later histories (memory and certificate) with probability p; it is still judged on its own score when it happens; deploy = selection on full histories

test1_exposure_full_rerun.note: whole nested selection (R49 cut-offs, memory threshold and hyper-parameters, certificate, check bar) rerun with training AND held-out non-progressors truncated; models not refitted

test7_permutation.note: labels permuted at patient level (free) or within endoscopy-count strata 1/2/3/4/5-6/7+ (strat: keeps the progressors' shorter histories, removes the signal); everything that uses labels is rerun: R49 cut-offs, memory threshold rule, half-life / certificate selection, check bars; models' stored predictions unchanged; excess = change in the share of NP flagged minus change in the share of progressors caught (0 expected when the rule only moves a threshold); best_of_grid_excess = OPTIMISTIC pick on the evaluation patients, among the A1 / A12 candidates x check bars (243 cells), of the lowest excess
